name: Ca hong
summary: Cá hồng is a fish from Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân says the lagoon holds it. A 1 October 2016 feature says guests eat fish of this name raised under a raft, and names no cooking method.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, for the fish in the lagoon. Viện Kinh tế xã hội Hà Nội, 1 October 2016, for guests eating it.
howToEat: The 2016 feature says guests eat it on the lagoon and does not name a grill, a soup, or a shop.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Lập An. No door is named.
